items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: and Sandy Williams from the Fletcher Henderson, trombone.

ctx.x: OR 32] And there was men in the band like Greely Walton; there was Jonas Walker, trombone; there was E.V. Perry on first trumpet; and Sandy Williams from the Fletcher Henderson, trombone. These are just the veterans I'm naming.
Was Louis Bacon with you, too.
